edges.reason: msg.sender determines the registering player identity and state writes in playGame.
msg.sender is used as the beneficiary _playerAddress in withdrawIncome.
Access to round advancement is gated by msg.sender == roundStarter.
Owner-only privileged withdrawal depends on msg.sender == owner.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged roles.
owner state variable guards the onlyOwner withdrawFees function.
owner state variable guards transferOwnership.
roundStarter state variable authorizes startNewRound.
settleIncome payout amount depends entirely on block.timestamp deltas.
startNewRound triggers on now > round endTime, a timestamp dependency.
getPlayerInfo result is derived from now versus lastSettledTime.
playGame writes lastSettledTime = now and round timing on block.timestamp.
r1 reserve is read, decremented and paid out in withdrawFees.
r2 reserve is read, decremented and paid out in withdrawFees.
r3 reserve is read and decremented by a caller-supplied amount in withdrawFees.
r3 flows into an unchecked subtraction, permitting underflow.
withdrawFees performs r3.sub(_amount) without verifying sufficient reserve.
playGame reads and writes player accounting fields.
settleIncome reads and writes player income fields.
withdrawIncome reads and zeroes player income fields.
referralBonusTransferDirect walks the player referrer chain.
withdrawFees with _numberUI == 3 arbitrarily credits player[_receiver].superIncome.
startNewRound reads and updates the round mapping.
playGame branches on playerExist to distinguish new and returning players.
playGame updates per-round self investment and referrer volume.
playGame adds the unassigned referral share into r1.
playGame adds 5% of deposits into the r3 reserve.
playGame credits the daily win pool of the current round.
playGame updates the owner's and player's income accounting.
Unfilled level commissions are accumulated into r1.
Unfilled ROI commissions are accumulated into r2.
settleIncome credits dailyIncome and reduces incomeLimitLeft.
getPlayerInfo reads player.lastSettledTime.
getPlayerInfo first checks playerExist for the queried address.
_transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
playGame invokes referralBonusTransferDirect to pay direct commission.
settleIncome invokes referralBonusTransferDailyROI on credited ROI.
withdrawIncome calls settleIncome before computing earnings.
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
Fallback forwards plain value transfers into playGame.
withdrawIncome performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender, enabling reentrancy.
withdrawFees transfers ETH to an arbitrary receiver address, an external call surface.
User-supplied _referrer steers the referral branch and commission flow in playGame.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable via _transferOwnership.

Owner-supplied amount drained from r1/r2/r3 inside withdrawFees.
Destination address of the privileged payout in withdrawFees.
Branch selector choosing which reserve is drained in withdrawFees.
Address assigned to the owner state variable through _transferOwnership.
Locally captured msg.value used for the in-function deposit accounting.
Aggregated payout local that is transferred out of withdrawIncome.
Snapshot of round[roundID].pool used only while rotating rounds.
Temporary upline pointer used only inside the direct referral loop.
Computed return value derived from block.timestamp in getPlayerInfo.
